target_customer: Fashion brands seeking sustainable polyester replacements
problem: Polyester dominates apparel and is hard to replace. ALT TEX ferments food waste into a biodegradable polymer that is melt extruded like polyester.
business_model: Fabric and fiber sales to fashion brands

founders.name: Myra Arshad
founders.background_notes: YC page says her family is in textile manufacturing.

founders.name: Avneet Ghotra
education: Left medical school; University of Toronto alumna per U of T news; background in biochemistry and environmental science
previous_startups: Approaching Zero (non-profit making reusable cotton produce bags)

technical_complexity.rationale: Fermentation derived polymer that must match polyester strength, spin on existing equipment and scale from lab prototype, which is materials science and scale up risk for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Patent pending process and know-how, but several funded bio-based polyester rivals exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found in sources.

market_need_then: Brands faced sustainability mandates and polyester is a large share of apparel fiber; the company cites 1M USD in letters of intent on its YC page.

branding.domain_note: Uses thealttex.com, not an exact short .com.
branding.community_and_virality: Coverage by CBC, Global News and CTV per company site; U of T Adams Sustainability Innovation Prize in January 2021 per BetaKit and U of T.

brand_strength.rationale: Modest press and prizes, name resembles the common phrase alt text which hurts search.

outcome_analysis: ALT TEX raised a pre-seed in May 2021 after university prizes and Creative Destruction Lab, joined YC in Summer 2022 and reports 2.3M USD raised in total on its YC page. It remains active with a team of 10, but no later round or commercial scale milestone was found in sources, so it sits in the capital intensive scale up phase typical of materials startups.
notes: The pre-seed was CAD 1.5M per BetaKit, cross-checked by Seedtable; USD amount not recorded to avoid conversion. Total raised is reported as 1.7M (one source) and 2.3M (YC page), unreconciled. The round precedes the batch start by over a month. No competitors with dates near mid 2022 were verified; later entrants such as Kintra Fibers (Series A reported 2023) are not recorded as competitors. No outcome news found after 2021 coverage.
